name: yt-flywheel-team
description: YouTube Evergreen Flywheel — team T1 of the freedomOS system, a 15-skill AI Agent Team in two clean layers. LAYER A (Playlist Strategy, once per playlist): playlist-strategy-orchestrator + Agent 01 + Agent 02 (Playlist Keyword Mode) decide the whole playlist concept, umbrella keyword and video sequence, then emit a PlaylistStrategy doc, one pre-generated Video Brief Card per planned video, and playlist_brief.json for the T2 funnel team — then STOP. LAYER B (Per-Video Execution, every video): video-production-orchestrator consumes one Brief Card and runs title/description (Agent 02 Execution Mode, its own tight per-video keyword pass), script, production core, thumbnail, publish. It reads optin_registry.json (written by T2) for the opt-in URL. FIVE video types in priority order (most to least used): avatar_local, avatar_native (short-form only), screen_recording, talking_head, faceless_generated — avatar/voice agnostic (own / standard HeyGen / client upload). The Video Brief Card is the layer interface; playlist_brief.json / optin_registry.json are the T1<->T2 contract (references/layer-interface.md). strategic-launch-orchestrator is a pointer only. Multi-channel, outputs in Google Drive.
